I am young but I farm my own land here in Ntcheu, and maize is what feeds my family. I managed to get a FISP coupon this season, so I will use the subsidized NPK and urea on my plot, though I will have to stretch it a bit because my plot is bigger than the 0.4 ha the pack is meant for. I am intercropping with beans to help the soil, and I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the coupon since it yields better. I cannot afford pesticide and there is no way to irrigate, so I will rely on the rains and my own hands, with maybe a few days of ganyu labor at weeding time.
